parameters.name: DBInstanceCategories
parameters.description: The instance edition. You can specify multiple editions. Separate multiple editions with a comma (,).

parameters.name: DBInstanceIds
parameters.description: The instance IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

parameters.name: DBInstanceModes
parameters.description: The resource type of the instance. You can specify multiple resource types. Separate multiple resource types with a comma (,).

parameters.name: InstanceDeployTypes
parameters.description: This parameter is deprecated. Do not specify this parameter.

parameters.name: InstanceNetworkType
parameters.description:
The instance network type. Valid values:

- **VPC**: VPC

- **Classic**: classic network

> If you omit this parameter, the operation returns instances of all network types.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values:

- **30**

- **50**

- **100**

Default value: **30**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the instance.

> You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~86912~~) operation to query the available region IDs.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The VPC ID. You can specify this parameter to query instances in a VPC.
